Un serveur intégré pour le contrôle par: An integrated server for artificial intelligence control
La version 11.0.9.565 de l'application N: NVIDIA app version 11.0.9.565, released on October 13, 2026, and marked as beta, integrates an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. This standard allows an artificial intelligence assistant to use the functions of another software. The option enabling this control is enabled by default after installing this update on PCs equipped with GeForce graphics cards.
Ce système autorise les assistants compa: This system allows compatible assistants, such as Hermes, OpenClaw, or Perplexity, to interact with the software in natural language to perform several specific actions.
Le serveur fonctionne en permanence en a: The server runs continuously in the background upon startup and listens exclusively to the local address 127.0.0.1 on port 13508, meaning no external service is directly connected to the machine without an installed agent. Nevertheless, this default activation raises cybersecurity concerns.
Pour couper l'accès et arrêter le serveu: To cut off access and stop the server, simply open the NVIDIA app, go to settings, and check the features tab. In the dedicated section, the switch allowing artificial intelligence agents to control the application can be disabled manually.
